name: memory-ledger
description: Memory Ledger — a graph-linked local memory + skills (remember, recall, tasks with micro-steps, reminders/alarms, calendar, email, Slack, Jira, web search, delegation, writing style) built as an external working memory for a busy brain. It records as you work and keeps what is still open: what you owe, to whom, by when. Talk to it in any language via Slack or chat with /ledger; it routes your message to the right skill, reaches connected machines (Calendar, Gmail, Slack, Jira), and keeps the memory graph up to date. Works in both Claude Code and the Claude app.
